snippet.title: God of War Sons of Sparta - The Pit | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Available on PS5® today!
Purchase Now or Learn More: https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/god-of-war-sons-of-sparta/
 
Take on The Pit – an endgame roguelite challenge mode in God of War Sons of Sparta that can be taken on solo or with retro-inspired 2-player local couch co-op!
